about.bio: I have ALWAYS loved color—especially how certain shades bring different emotions and how the right colors can completely change the way you look AND feel. Discovering color analysis took that love to another level. Once I knew my own palette, getting dressed became so much easier. I could open my closet, throw pieces together, and know they would work together and make my complexion glow. That's what made me want to help other people experience the same thing.
